_: The crowd's switch and the crown's market (town_life.gd crown_market; villagers.gd): on: --crowd=off and this off show the crown's market as before the crowd work (off: towns.json market.crown's buyers, porters, carts, how many the square holds and its places hold, how many are out); with it off the square's own life (town_scenes.json standing rows marked square) is not staged. Who stands and walks in a town's scenes, how many and how is town_scenes.json's (standing rows: the crier, beggars, the watch's beat, dogs, children chasing, gossip, guards at the forge and castle, carriers, the market cart, the yards). posted.lighten: the house's colour toward white on posted guards' cloth (town_life.gd house_colour). cart: the market cart as town_life.gd horse_cart builds it (load: sacks in its bed: how many, the bed's height and how far they run back, game units, and their size; market_in: how far in toward the market it draws up, villagers.gd). errands.sack: a porter's sack on the shoulder [up, back] metres from the shoulder bone and its size (town_life.gd shoulder_sack).
_square_agents: square_agents (supervisor 2026-11-12, Mac: 'the people behaviour is poor'; Manor Lords', Anno's and Foundation's villagers): the crown's square is walked by villagers on errands (villagers.gd, LimboAI trees in npc_mind.gd, Godot's NavigationServer2D walk map with RVO avoidance), not stood by posted figures. on: the switch (--square-agents=on|off). share: of the crown's villagers, how many take a square calling, drawn from callings by weight: market (the shopper: in off a street to a stall's front, haggles, takes the goods and leaves up a street; browses along the stalls; meets a neighbour), water (to the well's rim, draws, carries it home or to a stall), porter (sacks off the market cart's tail while it waits at the market, or a load in off a street, slung on the shoulder to a stall's pile; a box back out), gossip (meets a neighbour and talks, strolls by the stalls, waves and chats at the well). The cart's tail is a slot only while it waits at the market (cart.tail game units behind it). The square's smart objects offer slots a villager claims so none stack (villagers.gd _slot): three at each stall's front, stall_out game units before its counter; five round the well, well_rim out from its middle; two across each main street at street_out square radii; slot_clear: how far a slot is from anyone there or bound there. square_holds: how many villagers the square holds at once with this on (the posted figures no longer count against it). circle: a talk under way takes joiners up to most in its ring (within reach game units, each on a spot radius from its centre, facing in; the talk kept stay seconds more; a joiner stays secs [fewest, most]), turn-taking with the rest, a laugh among the listening; after a talk the gossip waves and walks off up a street. cooldown: seconds a slot stays shut after someone leaves it; queue_back: where one waits behind a stall whose three buying slots are all taken (game units further back; one a stall, stepping up as a slot frees, else off elsewhere; a stall with no keeper offers no slots); pile: the kept stall's stock on the ground at its end (props, most, aside game units past its end, size), one taken off at each sale and one set back by each porter's load. serve: a stall's keeper turns to a shopper at its front (villagers.at_stall) and serves them, talk, the hand-over, a nod, while they stand within reach game units and for at most within seconds after arriving. smith_in_smithy: with a smithy on the square (towns.gd _smithy) the open-air smith's anvil is not set out: the one smith works at his forge, quenching at its trough, the bellows boy fetching coal from its store. patrol.gate: the beat starts at the castle's gate (gate_out game units before its end toward the square) when the castle stands by the square. chase.stop: the share of catches after which the pair stop for a breather (rest seconds: laughing, bent over, pointing), their runs chosen on open cobble off stalls and plinths. patrol.mouth: with this on, a guard pair walks a beat from a main street's mouth (this many square radii out) past the well to the next mouth and back, stopping to look about at each.
_villagers: villagers (villagers.gd and its village_talk, village_slots): view_radius world units round the camera inside which a town has its people about; most_per_town the most villagers a town draws; walk_speed world units a second (an unhurried 1.4 m/s); child_reach how far a child strays from their parent, child_side where it stands by them; space the gap kept between two middles as they pass; talk_reach the furthest apart two may be and still talk; talk_lapse_secs when a minds' talk nobody closed lapses; shoulder two standing a shoulder apart; square_holds the most bound for the square at once in the biggest towns; square_edge how far past the paving is still the square; knot_clear the room a gathering keeps round its middle.
_minds: minds (npc_mind.gd): give_up_secs with no way to where they're going, the activity is off; partner_near how far a mind looks for someone to talk to; talk_gap how far apart two talking stand; news_fresh_ms how old news may be and still be talked of (chatter too); booked_ms how long an arranged talk waits to begin; partner_wait_secs how long one waits for the other to come; line_cap_secs the longest a talk is held for lines still being read; settled_secs face to face before the first word; settle_secs both standing before they talk where they are.
_chatter: chatter (chatter.gd): hear the camera within this of a gathering to overhear it; town_near a town talks with its centre within this of the camera; own_words_secs how long a talk waits for the minds' words before plain words of its own; said_fresh_ms how long a line said stays fresh.
